reasons.text: The 3.8 m projection suits a semi-detached house and keeps neighbours' light.
The protected oak's root protection area (7.7 m) is clear of the works at 11 m.

conditions.text: Tree protection fencing at 7.7 m from oak T1 before works start.

citations.quote: The extension projects 3.8 m beyond the original rear wall.
